proposals.before: The crown prince said: "Because it is not reached by practice that it can be the root of virtue."
proposals.after: The crown prince said: "It is because it is not reached by practice that it can be the root of virtue."
proposals.reason: Idiomatic English is ungrammatical; the Chinese 不因積習而至，所以可爲德本 needs a cleft or inverted result clause.

proposals.before: Because when Emperor Ming of Jin was crown prince had built the Western Pool, he memorialized Shizu citing that precedent and asked to raise a small park on the Eastern Fields; the emperor granted it.
proposals.after: Because when Emperor Ming of Jin was crown prince he had built the Western Pool, he memorialized Shizu citing that precedent and asked to raise a small park on the Eastern Fields; the emperor granted it.
proposals.reason: Literal English omits the subject pronoun 'he' before 'had built', yielding an ungrammatical clause.

decisions.reason: Chinese 不因積習而至，所以可爲德本 is a causal cleft: it is precisely because filial piety is not attained through accumulated practice that it can be the root of virtue. The original lacks the opening 'It is' and is ungrammatical; the proposed cleft restores that sense without changing meaning.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 不因積習而至，所以可爲德本

decisions.reason: In 以晉明帝爲太子時立西池 the builder of 西池 is Emperor Ming while crown prince; the original subordinate clause drops the finite subject before 'had built' and is ungrammatical. Adding 'he' restores grammar and keeps agent, patient, and the petition to Shizu intact.

sourceWitness.excerpt: 以晉明帝爲太子時立西池，乃啓世祖引前例，求東田起小苑，上許之
